text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, a crowd 
had gathered in front of an arcade.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The cause of the crowd is... an "AR Dance 
Game." 85% of our classmates are talking 
about it.
choice_data_list: Want to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes... however, this is a two-player 
match. And Master appears exhausted from 
daily duties.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Judging from the situation, let's try 
again another day...

Beep-beep-beep! The Class Rep Radar is 
pinging! You two over there, you need some 
help, don't you!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Encounter target identified. Bakushin 
O-san, what seems to be the matter?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I am a model Class Representative! Even 
after school, I'm on patrol to make sure 
no one is in need of assistance!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And... I have received the voice of 
Bourbon-san's heart!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I hear you crying, 'I need someone to 
battle in this dance game! Help!'"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Inner voice... That is factually 
incorrect. I am not transmitting 
brainwaves.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However... condition: 'A Windfall' 
confirmed. Rival acquired.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Proceeding to Operation: Track Selection. 
Master, your orders, please.
choice_data_list: Make it a cool dance song!

Give me an upbeat dance song to get 
everyone hyped!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Cool... One of my classmates said it. 
"It's cool if you can reach Level MAX."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I request a song with the MAX dance 
difficulty level.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming tough challenges is what makes 
an honor student! I gladly accept your 
request!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Relocation to AR Area complete. 
Commencing Operation "Dance Battle."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hoo... Fuu... Hoo, hoo...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu, not bad! However, I won't lose 
either............ wait, what!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~! To think the machine couldn't keep 
up with my speed! That was a complete 
blind spot!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You never know the outcome until the very 
end. I will now press the button to 
display the score.
(Click... bzzz... screeech!)

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Smoke's coming out of the dance 
machine! Wait... the data's completely 
wiped out~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Device malfunction visually confirmed. 
Score deletion, verified.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What in the world—!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission failure... Assessed that contact 
on my part was the cause. ...My apologies, 
Master.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! It's all about feeling, fighting 
spirit, and guts! Which means... I get a 
perfect score!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Feelings...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Master... how did my dance make 
you feel?
choice_data_list: I thought it was super cool!
I thought it was super cool!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The very... best...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A reason to celebrate! That means I have 
successfully fulfilled my duty as the 
class representative!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Heh... Yes. Mission complete.

And so, the heated dance battle came to a 
close with a victory for both of them!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Selecting a track from 
'Hype☆Classic Numbers.'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Class favorite! When it comes to hyping 
everyone up, I'm your girl! Challenge 
accepted!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Relocation to AR Area complete. 
Commencing Operation "Dance Battle."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Wah! Those two are really getting into 
the groove~! It kinda makes me want to 
dance too~!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...The temperature inside the shop is 
rising. It seems more people gathered than 
expected.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! The heat! You can really feel it 
radiating off them!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...! Master's cheers confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the chorus is coming up! Here we 
go, Bourbon-san!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Maximum output, full 
throttle—...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Game over. I have done... my 
absolute best...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What a wonderful... excitement! You get a 
giant, satisfied flower seal...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master... how was it?
choice_data_list: That really fired everyone up to the max!
That was as exciting as it gets!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. ...However, it is all 
thanks to Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master's cheers uplifted my spirits... and 
enhanced my performance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, they appeared to be 
"getting into the groove." ...I have 
logged this along with the importance of 
cheering.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see!? Does this mean I have fulfilled my 
duty as the class representative?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Heh... Yes. Mission complete.

And so, the heated dance battle came to a 
close with massive excitement for both of 
them...!
